opportunities.name_zh: Portage Valley・Portage Lake／高山冰河與U形谷
opportunities.best_time: 白天可見光；Trail of Blue Ice／Begich Boggs周邊公共區域實際可使用時
opportunities.best_season: 全年；Trail of Blue Ice官方資料為全年開放，雪冰狀態仍影響實際步行條件

condition_variants.variant_name: Portage Lake／Portage Valley＋周邊高山冰河
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"Begich Boggs / Trail of Blue Ice public Camera Zone","subject":"Portage Lake / glacial valley + surrounding alpine glaciers and mountains"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 公共步道／湖岸區合法可使用；不得宣稱Begich Boggs本身可直接看到已後退的Portage Glacier冰舌
condition_variants.required_conditions: 湖泊／谷地與周邊山稜、可見冰河主要層次清楚；能見度足夠
condition_variants.boosters: 高透明度；低角度光；雪線／冰河細節；平靜水面
condition_variants.penalties: 低雲／霧封谷；強降水；低能見度

viewpoints.note: USFS documents Trail of Blue Ice as an always-open public route with spectacular Portage Valley views. The contract deliberately does not claim the retreated Portage Glacier face is visible from the visitor center.
viewpoints.name: Begich Boggs / Trail of Blue Ice Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: Begich, Boggs Visitor Center湖岸與Trail of Blue Ice鄰近公共Camera Zone；實際步道範圍可延伸至Portage Valley。

opportunities.name_zh: Portage Glacier・MV Ptarmigan船上冰河正面
opportunities.best_time: 官方MV Ptarmigan實際有班次且可登船的時段；通常為夏季營運，但須以當年當日官方狀態為準
opportunities.best_season: 官方資料描述晚5月至9月初的季節性巡航；不得沿用靜態年份時刻表保證未來班次

condition_variants.variant_name: Portage Glacier冰舌＋Portage Lake船上近距離視角
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"MV Ptarmigan / authorized Portage Lake cruise mobile Camera Zone","subject":"Portage Glacier face + Portage Lake / surrounding mountains"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 官方當日巡航實際營運且使用者可合法登船；不得把靜態季節班表視為即時可用性
condition_variants.required_conditions: Portage Glacier主體在航線觀景位置可清楚辨識；班次未取消
condition_variants.boosters: 高透明度；低雲較少；柔和側光；冰山／浮冰僅作現況加分
condition_variants.penalties: 班次取消；強風／惡劣天候；低雲／霧遮冰河

viewpoints.note: USFS specifically recommends the MV Ptarmigan for a spectacular Portage Glacier view. This is a mobile on-lake Camera Zone; the Begich Boggs area is only the nearby weather/embarkation anchor.
viewpoints.name: MV Ptarmigan / Portage Lake Mobile Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: Portage Lake官方巡航移動觀景區；座標僅代表Begich Boggs附近登船／weather anchor，不宣稱船上固定拍攝點。
